name: Campaign Planning & Scoping
description: Ability to plan and scope red team campaigns including threat modelling, objective definition, rules of engagement negotiation, and campaign architecture. Covers translating client objectives into adversarial scenarios, selecting appropriate TTPs based on threat intelligence, and structuring multi-phase operations.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to red team campaign planning

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose of red team engagements and key planning artefacts
evidence: Completed red team methodology awareness training
Can describe the difference between penetration testing and red teaming
Understands the purpose of rules of engagement and threat models

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Contributes to campaign planning under supervision of an experienced operator
evidence: Assisted in developing campaign plans for 2+ engagements
Drafted rules of engagement documents reviewed by senior staff
Contributed to threat model selection and TTP mapping under guidance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Plans and scopes red team campaigns independently for standard corporate environments
evidence: Independently planned and scoped 3+ red team campaigns
Produced rules of engagement accepted by clients without major revision
Accurately estimated campaign duration, resource needs, and risk within 20%
Mapped campaign objectives to appropriate MITRE ATT&CK techniques

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Plans complex, multi-phase campaigns against mature defenders; mentors junior planners
evidence: Planned campaigns against organisations with active SOC and EDR coverage
Designed multi-phase campaigns spanning weeks with adaptive planning
Reviews and improves campaign plans produced by junior staff
Contributed to lab campaign planning methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines red team methodology at organisational level; plans CBEST/TIBER-EU/DORA TLPT-grade campaigns
evidence: Authored or maintained the lab's red team planning methodology
Produced red team test plans for CBEST, TIBER-EU / DORA TLPT, or equivalent regulatory engagements, working with the entity's control team on scenarios, leg-ups, and risk management
Trains teams on campaign planning and threat modelling
Recognised as authority on adversarial simulation planning

assessment_methods.description: Review of 3 recent campaign plans including rules of engagement, threat models, and TTP selections
Scenario: scope a red team engagement from a client brief, producing a campaign plan with threat model, phases, and rules of engagement
